cast.name: UV Villain
cast.description: gang of spiky golden UVA and red-orange UVB star villains streaking toward her face; gleeful, gravelly, menacing gremlin voice

cast.name: DERMDOC Sunscreen Tube
cast.description: the white DERMDOC Ultra Violet sunscreen tube with eyes, mouth and tiny limbs, team leader; firm, confident, protective cartoon voice

cast.name: SPF 50 PA+++ Shield
cast.description: cobalt-blue shield hero that throws up a force field against the UV rays; deep, strong, calm bodyguard voice

cast.name: Purple Tint

cast.name: 4% Niacinamide

lines.speaker: purple_tint
lines.en: Colour wheel says: I cancel yellow dullness!
lines.bn: কালার হুইল বলছে, হলদেটে ডালনেস আমি ক্যানসেল করি!
lines.ta: கலர் வீல் சொல்லுது, மஞ்சள் டல்னஸ் நான் கேன்சல் பண்றேன்!
lines.te: కలర్ వీల్ చెప్తోంది, పసుపు డల్‌నెస్ నేను క్యాన్సిల్ చేస్తా!
lines.ml: കളർ വീൽ പറയുന്നു, മഞ്ഞ ഡൾനെസ് ഞാൻ ക്യാൻസൽ ചെയ്യും!
lines.or: କଲର ହୁଇଲ କହୁଛି, ହଳଦିଆ ଡଲନେସ ମୁଁ କାଟିଦିଏ!

lines.speaker: niacinamide
lines.en: Made for Indian skin. Hello, instant glow!
lines.bn: ইন্ডিয়ান স্কিনের জন্য! হ্যালো, ইনস্ট্যান্ট গ্লো!
lines.te: ఇండియన్ స్కిన్ కోసమే తయారైంది! హలో, ఇన్‌స్టంట్ గ్లో!
lines.ml: ഇന്ത്യൻ സ്കിന്നിനായി തന്നെ! ഹലോ, ഇൻസ്റ്റന്റ് ഗ്ലോ!
lines.or: ଇଣ୍ଡିଆନ ସ୍କିନ ପାଇଁ ତିଆରି! ହେଲୋ, ଇନଷ୍ଟାଣ୍ଟ ଗ୍ଲୋ!

notes: Six lines by five characters, matching the prompt's speaker labels. The prompt's 'Protection and brightening, in one.' line is NOT spoken in the video (cut at 17 s), so it is omitted. The White Cast and Dullness villains appear on screen but are silent. The UV villain's original voice is fairly high (~248 Hz), so it gets villain fx plus -3 st to sound menacing. Tube, Purple Tint and Niacinamide all sit around 190-220 Hz in the original, so Purple Tint gets +3 and Niacinamide +2 to keep the three voices apart. The SPF Shield is the only deep voice (~121 Hz). The tube's two lines differ in pitch (221 vs 188 Hz) but the prompt labels both as SUNSCREEN. Whisper's voice_cluster_hint was ignored.
